evidence: STATIC (these bytes). tests/test.sh (sha256 bd682592...), tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile, scoring.toml and .dockerignore are byte-identical (diff) to the frozen template; `bash -n` passes; LF only; no `exec` builtin (only `find ... -exec chmod`, line 86). Contract walk: (1) test.sh:60-61 `write_zero_reward` then `trap cleanup EXIT`; cleanup (33-40) ends in `ensure_reward`; the zero record (line 8) carries reward, all five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op. (2) line 68 `if [[ ! -f /app/server.js ]]; then exit 0`; lines 72-83 refuse any symlink outside /app/node_modules or whose `readlink -f` target leaves /app/node_modules, before any chmod/chown/cp. (3) lines 90-95 copy /app to /tmp/submission; lines 104-111 launch with `setsid env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT DB_PATH setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups node "$APP_ENTRY"`; umask 077, LOG_DIR 700 and `chmod -R go-rwx /tests` keep the unprivileged app away from the rubric and the reward files. (4) lines 115-125 probe /api/health then / for up to 120 tries and `exit 0` (zero kept) when not ready, before any rewardkit call. (5) lines 127-193 helper by heredoc + sed, chmod 755, `export APP_RESTART_HELPER`; functional judge.toml passes `$APP_RESTART_HELPER` to restart_mcp.py. (6) lines 195-201 substitute {app_context}; tests/app_context.md exists. (7) line 213 gates suite first (`timeout 1500 rewardkit ...`), failure -> exit 0 with zero; 217-222 score.py: 0 continues, 1 exits keeping the detailed record, other -> write_zero_reward. (8) line 224 scored suite (11100), then line 227 `score.py "$LOG_DIR" || write_zero_reward`. Every exit path I enumerated (missing judge env, missing server.js, symlink escape, cp/chown failure under set -e, not live, gates suite crash/timeout, score.py exit 1 / 2, scored suite crash/timeout, score.py failure, normal end) leaves a non-empty reward.txt and reward.json because the zero is written before the first fallible grading step and score.py writes complete records. Budgets nest: gates 600+600=1200<1500; scored 9000+900+900=10800<11100; 1500+11100=12600<13200. The brief states the cwd assumption (integration.md:3 'from a working directory that may be outside /app'). ACTUAL RUN (earlier candidate only, not these bytes): the hosted Oracle's verifier/app-restart.sh is identical to the helper the current test.sh lines 128-183 would generate (diff after placeholder substitution: no difference), so the same entrypoint logic produced reward.txt 0.9833 with graded=1 on the full path and `app-restart pid=1961 ready=1`; the nop trial produced the plain zero record (graded=0, no_op=1, reward 0.0) via the missing-server.js path; the model trial produced render=0.0, gates_passed=0, reward 0.0, graded=1 via the score.py exit-1 path. Scripted golden on these bytes launched the app the way test.sh does (uid 65534, env -i, cwd /tmp) and survived one restart (restart.json hash verified), but did not run tests/test.sh itself. NOT EXERCISED on any bytes: scored-suite timeout/crash path and score.py exit-2 path (read only). NOTES, both in template-controlled bytes, neither a task-authoring defect: (a) P3 - when the scored suite fails after gates pass, line 224-226 exits keeping the post-gates record (reward 0.0, gates_passed=1, graded=1, no_op=0) rather than the 'plain zero' that contract step 8 words; a reward is still written and it is 0, but an evaluator failure there is recorded as graded. (b) P3 - the restart helper sends only SIGTERM and waits 5 s (test.sh:154-158) and its probe cannot tell the old process from the new one, so an app that ignores SIGTERM would keep in-memory state, the relaunch would die on EADDRINUSE, and restart_app would still report success; latent, requires an app that swallows SIGTERM, not observed.
